parse.title: Beginner Guide
parse.wikitext:
== First Spawn ==
You spawn as a Human — there is no choice at spawn.

You start at Lv 0 with only your fists. Daylight is safe for you. Do outdoor villager quests while the sun is up, earn cash, and buy better weapons before night falls.

== Choosing a Path ==
You start as a Human, but you don't have to stay one. Each path changes how you play — follow the link for the full details on each one.

=== Human ===
Stay Human and progress through villager quests, cash bounties, and hunting with purchased weapons. Humans are the only path with a stat tree, and they're safe in daylight. See [[Human]].

=== Witch ===
Find a randomly spawning Grimoire in the woods and make a pact to respawn as a Witch. Witches cast with a Spell Cauldron, climb a level ladder from Novice to Scarce, and form covens. See [[Witch]] and [[Witch Spells]].

=== Vampire ===
Vampires are fast and lethal, but they must feed constantly and burn in sunlight. They form bloodlines, and at Lv 3,000 can command minions. See [[Vampire]].

=== Werewolf ===
As a Human, get scratched by a Lv 6,000+ werewolf (5% infection chance per scratch) and transform at the next full moon. Werewolves manage hunger by eating bodies, and can unlock full wolf mode with the Werewolf Ring. See [[Werewolf]].

== Beyond the Three Paths ==
* '''[[Original Vampire]]''' — the top of the food chain, obtained only via the Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED) gamepass (1,895 Robux, 1,706 with Premium). Sunlight damages but cannot kill one — only a White Oak Stake can.
* '''[[Original Hybrid]]''' — half vampire, half werewolf. Requires Lv 5,000, a Lv 3,000+ transforming player, and the Original Vampire gamepass, at a 0.5% chance (also stated as 0.1% — the rate has changed over time).
* '''[[Hybrid]]''' — a separate variation, coming in a later update. Not obtainable yet.
* '''[[Cannibal Vampire]]''' — a stronger vampire variant that feeds only on vampire blood.
* '''[[Cannibal Raised Vampire]]''' — the same ~20% stat raise, but it can drink any blood without losing status.
* '''[[Vegan Vampire]]''' — a vampire who feeds only on rats earns the Vegan Vampire tag.
* '''[[Vampire Hunter]]''' — a Human sub-race, unlocked by completing the quest at the windmill tower near the Merchant in front of the Vampire Castle.

== How Turning Works ==
To become a Vampire, you must have vampire blood in your system, die while it is active, then drink fresh blood or a blood bag to complete the change.

Vampires can also turn Humans with the Infect ability — see [[Vampire#Abilities]].

Turning is reversible: buy a Human Potion from the merchant at the first village for 50 in-game money to revert back to Human.

== How to Level Up ==
* Complete villager quests and notice-board bounties for XP and cash.
* Feed (vampire) or hunt (human) for XP.
* Vampires can use the sleep move (B) for slow passive AFK XP. XP boosts do not affect sleep XP.
* XP boosts last 30 minutes each, are purchased or obtained by using codes, and stack with the 2x XP weekend event, which starts every Friday:
** 2x XP — 295 Robux (266 with Plus)
** 3x XP — 495 Robux (446 with Plus)
** 4x XP — 795 Robux (716 with Plus)

== Sunlight Survival ==
Vampires outdoors in sunlight catch fire and take heavy burn damage. Protection options: stay indoors/in the castle, Temporary Sun Ring, Sun Ring (gamepass — 695 Robux, 626 with Premium — or crafted by a witch), Vampire Hat (400 in-game money at spawn), or Vampire Cape. Vampires also take burn damage in holy places such as churches and cannot enter church interiors.

== Early Threats ==
Red-glowing villagers (carry stakes, can one-shot a low-level vampire), town guards (high health and damage), and running out of stamina mid-fight.
